Script.title: Script
Script.description: A user-authored script or code showcase card synced in Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the script owner.

title.description: Display title of the script card (1 to 120 characters).

scriptContent.description: Full script, code snippet, or text payload (1 to 50000 characters).

localImagePath.description: Optional on-device path to a locally stored cover image.

sampleDrawableName.description: Optional bundled drawable resource name for seeded sample cards.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() at creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create/update.

/users/{userId}/scripts/{scriptId}.description: User-isolated collection of script showcase cards owned by {userId}.
